causes.label: unscheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: At the time of the high prices, Victoria and NSW each had two unplanned coal unit outages. This meant 2,325 MW of baseload capacity, most of which is typically offered at low prices, was unavailable during the high prices.

causes.quote: Neoen in South Australia rebid its Blyth Battery capacity from both low to high and high to low prices due to a change in its state of charge, and effectively shifted a net capacity of 100 MW from low to high prices impacting the high price at 5.30pm.
